remarks: Tucked away in the back of the community, this beautifully refreshed townhouse offers a quiet and private setting while keeping you close to everything. Featuring 4 spacious bedrooms, each with its own private ensuite bathroom, this home provides exceptional comfort, privacy, and convenience. Enjoy brand-new remodeled bathrooms, fresh interior paint, new laminate flooring throughout, and new recessed dimmable lighting that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. Ideally located just 5 minutes from Downtown Burbank and approximately 15 minutes from Glendale Galleria, with easy access to shopping, restaurants, grocery markets, and major freeways.
